title: [DOC2-18] gsuite profile still relies on a custom `AgoraDIDAdmin` OAuth scope
description: Review finding DOC2-18: gsuite profile still relies on a custom `AgoraDIDAdmin` OAuth scope (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/gsuite-employer-did.md:299, :410; contradicted by :446. Fix: :299 "Google OAuth token with the `AgoraDIDAdmin` scope (§7)" contradicts :446 "No custom OAuth scope", and §7 defines no admin mechanism. Authorize admin calls by mapping the token `sub` to a sidecar admin list or Google group, and define the `AgoraDIDAdmin` "role" at :410 as that sidecar-side mapping. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
